_comment: Light colours for ColorLight (an optional client mod), read only when it's installed. Every block of this mod that gives light is named here (CompatTests checks it). Redstone ore in every host stone glows red as vanilla's does (ColorLight's texture guess picks the stone's colour for the pale hosts). A dyed lamp can be any colour, kept per lamp, which a block-wide entry can't follow: this warm white is its light till this mod's client code (ColorLightLamps) gives each lit lamp's light the lamp's own colour.
